DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)

The serology confirms M. leprae infection, and your physical exam findings of hypopigmented patches with loss of sensation and hair, along with peripheral neuropathy, are classic for this condition. The "puffy" appearance noted likely represents lepromatous infiltration, and we should proceed with skin smear examination and multidrug therapy planning.
